courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 防洪牆基礎設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」與「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；防洪牆基礎設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" and "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Floodwall foundation design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從預警物流到水密與可靠度的移動防洪部署；防洪牆基礎設計則以從靜水力到接觸與變形的防洪牆基礎推導為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deployable flood protection from warning logistics to sealing and reliability; Floodwall foundation design centres on floodwall foundation reasoning from hydrostatic action to contact and movement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「預警提前量與時間餘裕」與「靜水荷載與作用點」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到防洪牆基礎設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Warning lead time and float” and “Hydrostatic load and lever arm”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Floodwall foundation design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 河川水位自動遙測
related.transfer: 可遷移「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」與「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河川水位自動遙測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" and "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Automatic river-level telemetry must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從預警物流到水密與可靠度的移動防洪部署；河川水位自動遙測則以把水位感測、時間與發布品質連成可追溯資料鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deployable flood protection from warning logistics to sealing and reliability; Automatic river-level telemetry centres on connecting stage sensing, timing and publication quality into a traceable chain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「預警提前量與時間餘裕」與「測站基準與水面高程」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河川水位自動遙測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Warning lead time and float” and “Gage datum and water elevation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Automatic river-level telemetry, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 移動式防洪擋板部署
history.text: 環境署技術報告版權日期為2011年八月，雖資料頁標題保留2010字樣，本課依全文區分出版日期與計畫名稱。比尤德利塞文河南區於2006年完成，2020年維護公告說明接縫與地面滲漏仍需持續管理；比爾斯角於2025年九月達營運完工，細部景觀工作當時仍續作。科隆官方營運資料另說明固定與活動防線按河水位分段配合。本課不複製這些城市的實際啟動門檻，歷史產品清單也不當作現行供應或認證。
history.textEn: The Environment Agency technical report carries an August 2011 copyright date, although its landing-page title retains 2010; this course distinguishes the document date from that label. Severnside South completed in 2006, and a 2020 maintenance release shows continuing management of joints and ground seepage. Beales Corner reached operational completion in September 2025 while minor landscaping continued. Cologne’s operator separately describes staged interaction of fixed and mobile defences with river level. The course copies no city operating trigger and treats historical product listings as neither current availability nor certification.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」到「演練證據與失敗率界限機理與驗證」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" through "Exercise evidence and failure-rate bounds mechanism and verification" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
